about: Queue for the Long Hamstrings (Hamstrings & Legs) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/legs.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/legs/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "legs".

clips.name: Good Morning
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, knees slightly soft, hands behind the head with the elbows wide.
clips.motion: keeping the back flat and the knees soft, he pushes his hips back and hinges forward until his torso is almost parallel to the floor, pauses, then drives the hips forward to stand tall. He never rounds the back and never squats down.
clips.glow: only both hamstrings, on the back of the thighs, from behind the knees all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bones, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and both glutes. No glow on the front of the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Straight Leg Raise
clips.start: lying on his back, both legs straight on the floor with the toes pointing up, arms flat by his sides.
clips.motion: keeping both knees locked straight and the left leg pressed into the floor, he lifts the right leg straight up as high as it goes, pauses, then lowers it slowly to the floor. Only the right leg moves and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh, from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip crease, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right hamstring stretching, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Seated Forward Fold
clips.start: sitting on the floor, legs straight and together in front, toes pointing up, spine tall, hands resting on the thighs.
clips.motion: keeping the legs straight, he folds forward from the hips with a long back, sliding the hands down toward the feet, pauses, then sits back up tall. He never bends the knees.
clips.glow: only both hamstrings, on the back of the thighs, from behind the knees all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bones, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and both calves. No glow on the front of the thighs or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
clips.start: lying on his back, left leg straight on the floor, right leg raised straight up toward the ceiling, both hands clasped behind the right thigh.
clips.motion: keeping both legs straight and the left leg on the floor, he gently pulls the right leg closer toward his face, pauses, then lets it ease away a little. He never bends the right knee and never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg, the arms or the front of the thighs. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Hamstring Bridge
clips.start: lying on his back, knees only slightly bent, heels on the floor far from the hips with the toes pointing up, arms flat by his sides.
clips.motion: digging the heels into the floor, he lifts his hips until the body is a straight line from the shoulders to the heels, pauses, then lowers the hips to the floor. The heels stay planted.
clips.glow: only both hamstrings, on the back of the thighs, from behind the knees all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bones, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and both glutes. No glow on the front of the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Standing Quad Stretch
clips.start: standing tall on the left leg, right knee bent so the right heel is close to the right glute, right hand holding the right ankle, left arm straight out to the side for balance.
clips.motion: keeping the knees side by side and the torso upright, he gently pulls the right heel closer to the glute and pushes the right hip forward, pauses, then eases off a little. He never lets go of the ankle and never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the front of the right thigh (the quads), from the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the hip, with the top part glowing on the black shorts. No glow on the left leg, the arms or the back. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, knees soft, holding a light kettlebell by the handle with both hands in front of the thighs, arms straight.
clips.motion: keeping the back flat and the arms straight, he pushes the hips back and slides the kettlebell down the front of his legs to just below the knees, pauses, then drives the hips forward to stand tall. He never squats down and never rounds the back.
clips.glow: only both hamstrings, on the back of the thighs, from behind the knees all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bones, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and both glutes. No glow on the front of the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Half Split Rocks
clips.start: kneeling on the left knee, right leg straight out in front with the right heel on the floor and the toes pointing up, hips stacked over the left knee, hands on the floor on both sides of the right leg.
clips.motion: keeping the right leg straight and the hands on the floor, he rocks his hips back toward the left heel while folding his chest over the right leg, pauses, then rocks the hips forward over the left knee again. He never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right calf. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Elevated Hamstring Stretch
clips.start: standing facing a low box, left leg straight on the floor, right heel resting on the box with the right leg straight and the toes pointing up, hands on the hips.
clips.motion: keeping both legs straight and the back flat, he hinges forward over the right leg, pauses, then stands back up tall. He never switches legs and never takes the heel off the box.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right calf. No glow on the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Single Leg Hamstring Bridge
clips.start: lying on his back, right heel on the floor far from the hips with the right knee only slightly bent, left leg pointing straight up at the ceiling, arms flat by his sides.
clips.motion: digging the right heel into the floor, he lifts his hips as high as he can while the left leg keeps pointing up, pauses, then lowers the hips to the floor. He never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the right glute. No glow on the left leg, the front of the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Standing Pike Fold
clips.start: standing with the feet together and the legs straight, torso folded forward over the legs, hands holding the backs of the ankles.
clips.motion: keeping the legs straight, he gently pulls with his hands to draw his chest closer to his legs, pauses, then eases off a little. He never bends the knees and never stands up.
clips.glow: only both hamstrings, on the back of the thighs, from behind the knees all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bones, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and both calves. No glow on the front of the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Front Split Negatives
clips.start: in a half split: left knee on the floor under the hips, right leg straight out in front with the right heel on the floor, hands on the floor on both sides of the hips.
clips.motion: keeping both hands on the floor for support, he lets the right heel slide slowly forward along the floor, lowering the hips toward the floor as far as is comfortable, pauses, then pulls the right heel back to the start with the help of his hands. He never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right hamstring, on the back of the right thigh, from behind the right knee all the way up under the shorts to the sitting bone, with the top part glowing on the black shorts, and the front of the left hip. No glow on the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
